title: An item's state.json
description: The item's status, run state and counters (graphs.md, "Item data outside the document", D-615; core.md, "Run state", D-3; steps.md, "Counting"). F-137 D8 owns it; the record schema refers to its properties. A later feature that stores another fact in state.json adds its property here, in its own story. Whether `status` names a status of the item's type is the flow set's check (F-139).

run.description: The run state as stored: `idle`, `active: <box>`, `waiting: <box>`, `gated: <to status>` or `gated before: <box>` (D-3). `interrupted` is found when bl reads, never stored.

Counter.description: A counter of the `increment` step; a counter with no `value` reads 0.
